fields.label: Window (seconds)
fields.description: Refill window for the CALL-rate buckets. Blank = code default (60).

fields.label: Per-token Rate (calls/window)
fields.description: Sustained API CALLS per window for ONE partner (single or bulk = 1 call each). 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (1200).

fields.label: Per-token Burst (calls)
fields.description: Per-partner call-bucket capacity (max instantaneous burst). 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (1200).

fields.label: Global Rate (calls/window)
fields.description: Sustained API CALLS per window across ALL partners combined. 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (6000).

fields.label: Global Burst (calls)
fields.description: Global call-bucket capacity (max instantaneous burst across all partners). 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (6000).

fields.label: Volume limits (rows/day)
fields.description: Row (record) budgets — single + bulk combined, read and write metered separately. Cost = rows touched. Guards against cheap bulk scraping while letting real bulk loads run.

fields.label: Volume Window (seconds)
fields.description: Refill window for the row (volume) buckets. Blank = code default (86400 = 1 day).

fields.label: Per-token Read Rows/window
fields.description: Rows a partner may READ per window (single + bulk combined). 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (25000).

fields.label: Global Read Rows/window
fields.description: Rows READ per window across ALL partners combined. 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (125000).

fields.label: Per-token Write Rows/window
fields.description: Rows a partner may WRITE per window (single + bulk combined). 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (25000).

fields.label: Global Write Rows/window
fields.description: Rows WRITTEN per window across ALL partners combined. 0 = unlimited. Blank = code default (125000).

fields.label: Bulk Max Records
fields.description: Max records per bulk write call. 0 is rejected (an unbounded bulk is a footgun). Blank = code default (100).

fields.label: List Max Page
fields.description: Max records returned per read/list call. 0 is rejected. Blank = code default (200).

fields.label: List Default Page
fields.description: Page size when the caller omits `limit`. 0 is rejected. Blank = code default (20).

fields.label: File Download Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Timeout when re-hosting an attachment from a partner-supplied source URL. 0 is rejected. Blank = code default (30).

fields.label: File Download Max Size (MB)
fields.description: Max size (MB) of an attachment re-hosted from a partner-supplied source URL; a larger download is rejected. 0 is rejected. Blank = code default (25).

fields.label: Idempotency Window (hours)
fields.description: How long a stored Idempotency-Key + response is honoured for retry replay before the daily purge drops it. Opt-in per request. Blank = code default (24).
